subject: Mobile Development
title: How Touch Events Work
description: Learn How Touch Events Work in one minute.

hook.text: You tap a button and it responds. Beneath that tap, a complex event chain fires.

buildup.text: The screen detects electrical changes from your finger at up to 240 times per second.

discovery.text: The OS turns raw coordinates into gesture events: tap, swipe, pinch, long press.

twist.text: The system must decide in milliseconds: is this a tap, a scroll start, or a swipe?

climax.text: Touch handling is a real-time decision system that makes interfaces feel responsive.

punchline.text: Your phone reads your finger 240 times a second.

quiz.question: What does the OS interpret raw touch coordinates as?
options: Gesture events like tap, swipe, and pinch
